description: This file contains a class 'CommonStorageTests' which implements a suite of storage-related unit tests for Orleans grain storage back-ends. It includes methods for creating test grain references, writing, reading, and clearing grain states, and testing concurrency and exception scenarios.

classes.name: CommonStorageTests
classes.description: A class providing a suite of unit tests for verifying storage back-end implementations in Orleans, including state read/write, concurrency, and exception handling scenarios.

methods.name: GetTestReferenceAndState
methods.description: Creates a test grain reference and state pair using either a long or string grain ID.

methods.name: PersistenceStorage_Relational_WriteReadIdCyrillic
methods.description: Tests writing and reading a grain state with Cyrillic characters in the ID.

methods.name: PersistenceStorage_WriteDuplicateFailsWithInconsistentStateException
methods.description: Tests that writing a duplicate state with null ETag throws an InconsistentStateException.

methods.name: PersistenceStorage_WriteInconsistentFailsWithInconsistentStateException
methods.description: Tests that attempting to read a state with an inconsistent version throws an InconsistentStateException.

methods.name: PersistenceStorage_WriteReadWriteReadStatesInParallel
methods.description: Performs parallel write/read operations on multiple grain states to test concurrency and version updates.

methods.name: Store_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Writes, clears, and reads back grain state, asserting correctness of each operation.

methods.name: Store_WriteRead
methods.description: Writes and reads back grain state, asserting that the state and version match.
